symptom: Every Microflows$AnnotationFlow was written OriginConnectionIndex 2 -> DestinationConnectionIndex 0 (note bottom -> element top) wherever the note sat, so a note placed BELOW its activity drew its line out of its own bottom edge and round both boxes. The reader dropped the stored sides too, so a rewrite of a Studio Pro-drawn note below its activity flipped it to 2 -> 0.
cause: annotationFlowToGen hardcoded SetOriginConnectionIndex(2)/SetDestinationConnectionIndex(0), and microflows.AnnotationFlow had no field for the sides, so neither the builder nor the reader could say otherwise
insight: The issue proposed a separate note numbering (top 0, bottom 1, left 2, right 3); measuring Studio Pro's own documents refuted it in one pass: 891 AnnotationFlows from ako/TestApp, PedApp and the mx-test-projects .mpk apps (523 distinct). A note level with its activity on the left stores 1 -> 3 and on the right 3 -> 1, which only the activity numbering (0 top, 1 right, 2 bottom, 3 left) explains; a note below stores 0 -> 2 (58 of 67). The element side follows 'vertically clear -> top/bottom, else left/right' in 98%; the NOTE side is not predictable from geometry (Studio Pro often stores 1 -> 0 for a note above, presumably from where the author dragged), so do not chase the origin past 'the facing side'. Sides are chosen after separateRows, because notes are placed before rows and containers settle, and loop-body positions are relative to the loop's top-left, so the comparison is done in absolute coordinates.
